title: Card actions
description: Quick actions on a card or media tile: round icon buttons in the top right corner that show on hover or keyboard focus where the device can hover, and one always-visible ⋯ with every action on touch screens. Goes inside a `group relative` card.
when: Cards and media tiles in a grid (suppliers, products, templates, files) that open on click and have one or two quick actions.
A card's ⋯ overflow (G4 for grids: one or two inline actions at most, the rest in ⋯, danger last).
a11y: A group named by `label` (with the item's name); every icon button has an aria-label and a title; the hover row is in the tab order and shows on focus; on touch the ⋯ is always visible, so it never depends on hover.
Clicks inside do not reach the card under it.
